title: Boss head icons rendered from the boss models (Blender)
player_outcome: The boss bar shows each boss's actual head, rendered from the same 3D model you fight: King Slime's crown, the Eye's iris, Skeletron's skull.
design:
New tools/blender/bgen/boss_icons.py: `render_boss_icons(bosses, only)`.
- For each non-minor boss in content, import assets/models/creatures/<model>.glb with bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf (no rebuild of the models).
- Call export.render_icon(objs, REPO/'assets/icons/bosses/<id>.png', 'boss', size=64, samples=16).
export.render_icon gains a 'boss' view: front direction (0,1,0.15); the ortho frame fits the top 60 % of the bounds (the head), or the head segment for worms.
tools/blender/build_all.py: `--boss-icons` (with `--only`) calls the module. `--check` also fails when a non-minor boss lacks its icon.

Core:
- AssetPaths.BossIcon(EnemyDef) => assets/icons/bosses/{Boss.Icon ?? Id}.png.
- The ContentValidator enemies pass calls ctx.Asset for non-minor bosses.
- AssetCoverageTests.EveryBossHasAHeadIcon.
Commit the PNGs and their .import files.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Content/Validation/ContentValidator.World.cs (or the enemies validator file) — boss icon asset check
verification: python3.13 tools/blender/build_all.py --boss-icons; inspect king_slime, eye_of_cthulhu, skeletron and moon_lord PNGs; boss bar screenshot
risks: Rigged models import in rest pose. Pose them on frame 0 of the 'idle' action when one exists.
Bosses rebuilt by the bosses or art phases need their icons re-rendered. The --check catches missing icons, not stale ones, so note it in that phase's WP.
